title: Zariski sheaf property of a functor
statement:
Let $F:(\mathit{Sch})^{\mathrm{op}}\to\textit{Sets}$ be a functor. $F$
*satisfies the sheaf property for the Zariski topology* if for every
scheme $T$, every open covering $T=\bigcup_{i\in I}U_i$ and every
collection $\xi_i\in F(U_i)$ with
$\xi_i|_{U_i\cap U_j}=\xi_j|_{U_i\cap U_j}$ there is a unique
$\xi\in F(T)$ with $\xi|_{U_i}=\xi_i$ (Schemes, Definition 26.15.3, Tag
[01JI](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01JI)).

mathlib_match.how: Specializes to CategoryTheory.Presieve.IsSheaf AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.zariskiTopology F for F : Schemeᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w. Read SheafOfTypes.lean:65-80 and 135-150: Presieve.isSheaf_pretopology (line 138) expresses exactly the condition on covering families. Scheme.zariskiPretopology and Scheme.zariskiTopology, Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/BigZariski.lean:46,50,53, are the open-immersion covering topology and its equality with the generated pretopology. Scheme.mem_pretopology_iff, Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/Pretopology.lean:73-78, identifies covering presieves with Scheme.OpenCover families (Cover/Open.lean:43). Presieve.isSheafFor_arrows_iff_pullbacks, Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/IsSheafFor.lean:968-972, gives all clauses verbatim: a family of sections compatible after both projections admits a unique section restricting to each member. Its Arrows.PullbackCompatible definition is at 955-957. For open inclusions, overlaps are intersections by AlgebraicGeometry.isPullback_opens_inf, Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Restrict.lean:602-606. Open immersion sources are canonically isomorphic to their open images by Scheme.Hom.isoOpensRange at Restrict.lean:423-430, so allowing arbitrary open immersions instead of literal open subschemes does not change this condition. These are existing Mathlib declarations, not new equivalence lemmas. No nonempty-cover, affine, separated, or finiteness hypothesis is imposed.
